items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: If he had been there with Jay McShann, he would have got a taste of it when he was there.

ctx.x: I guess you know the story behind that. They had played a lot on the bandstand. They'd throw spitballs. So one hit Cab and he swore that Dizzy threw it. And he was the physical type. He invited Dizzy outdoors after they got off. Dizzy laughed and said okay. So when they got off the bandstand and went out in the alley, Cab threw back and hit Diz and Diz ducked the blow and pulled out his knife and cut him across the buttocks. So he was fired immediately. But he had to pay him two weeks salary to fire him, you…
Are you saying that Dizzy didn't start it?
